source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Adds MCC 5172 and 5983 as real exclusion rows on BPCL SBI OCTANE and IDFC FIRST HPCL Power+. Lata's exclusion tables list non-BPCL / non-HPCL fuel as 5172, 5541, 5542, 5983. 5.3.0 held back all four because seed/merchants.json maps the bpcl and hpcl merchants to 5541 and 5542, and the app checks exclusions before any reward rule, so writing those two zeroes each card's own headline fuel rate (L6.RULE_EXCLUDED_BY_OWN_CARD). That reasoning only covers 5541 and 5542. No fuel merchant we ship carries 5172 (wholesale petroleum) or 5983 (fuel dealers), so those two are now written as enforceable mcc rows and the remaining two are named, with the reason, in an adjacent row.
